derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.79 showed that neither dense heatmaps nor low-dimensional waypoint ridge can causally predict discretionary future turns. This prototype stops treating every radial marker as a route-blocking alert: r7.25 entry opens a non-directional construction-context notice, while frozen r7.56 past-only ego trace may escalate to a route-blocking avoidance alert. Missing causal intent remains uncertain rather than being forced into safe/risk.

causal_trace.implementation: exact frozen r7.56 DIS current-to-past flow

tier_1.name: construction_context_attention
tier_1.message_semantics: construction marker or narrowed-area context ahead; proceed carefully

tier_2.name: route_blocking_avoidance
tier_2.message_semantics: marker overlaps the currently committed motion corridor

alert_policy.uncertainty: if tier 1 is active but tier 2 evidence is absent, retain context attention and emit no directional avoidance claim
alert_policy.clear: frozen r7.30 nine consecutive marker-absent samples
